text:
sam: hey design — quick ask. i'm poking at the playground run history and the function-def hover that shows arg previews. feels noisy and hard to scan. any quick copy/layout ideas? maria: agree. current tooltip shows name + full JSON value, which can be huge. can we collapse long values and show type instead? e.g., "name: string — "John Doe..."" or show first 80 chars then "…" alex: +1 on truncation. also keyboard users need to be able to open the full preview with Enter or Space. make sure the hover has an accessible label like "Argument preview for " and id referenced by aria-describedby. kelly: captured a few microcopy variants: - Variant A: "Preview inputs — hover to expand" (short, actiony) - Variant B: "Argument preview: shows type and truncated value" (explicit) - Variant C: "Show sample value" (friendly) Which do you think reads best in the compact run-history row? sam: love those. my priority: scannability in the compact timeline (we only have ~200px). prefer shorter. maybe: "Preview value — type + truncated" or even "Value preview" maria: for actions, move "copy snippet" out of the tooltip and into the row \u2014 less accidental clicks. also add a small chevron to indicate expand/collapse so it behaves like a disclosure. alex: accessibility nit: when preview expands, focus should land on the expanded panel and Escape collapses it. screen reader announcement: "Expanded argument preview for ". also ensure contrast on the truncated badge. sam: quick mock (pseudo): ``` user_id Value preview
Argument preview: user_id (string)
"alexa-long-example-..."
 ``` kelly: nice. for copy options my vote is Variant A but label it "Value preview" to keep it short. We should test both A and B in the run-history where rows are dense. design-bot: New ticket created: #PL-1283 "Compact arg preview: copy + a11y" — https://go/redwood/PL-1283 maria: tiny translation/localization note: avoid punctuation-heavy phrases, some langs expand length. keep the primary label < 18 chars. alex: also flag for QA: voiceover reads when expanded, and keyboard nav cycles inside the tooltip only. I can add a quick checklist to the ticket. kelly: perfect. next steps: sam to update mock with "Value preview" label + chevron, maria to add copy variants to ticket, alex to add a11y checklist. i'll schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow to pick final copy. :thumbsup:
